newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovenska Sporitelna says signs $80mln subord debt.
newsitem.headline: Slovenska Sporitelna says signs $80mln subord debt.

text.p: Slovakia's largest savings bank, Slovenska Sporitelna a.s. said on Friday it had signed an $80 million subordinated debt issue lead managed by Merill Lynch.
State-owned Sporitelna said the debt will be in the form of a 10-year floating rate note issued in two tranches.
The first five-year tranche will carry an interest rate of LIBOR plus 125 basis points and the second tranche a rate of LIBOR plus 300 basis points.
The issue is co-managed by Chase Manhattan and Taiwan's Hua Nan Commercial Bank.
More than half the issue will be placed in Europe, 10 percent in the United States and the rest in the Far East.
